data.title: Real-World Percents: Discounts, Tax, and Tips
data.description: Practice calculating and visualizing practical financial scenarios involving discounts, taxes, and tips using a percent bar model.

challenges.question: You have already used 60% of them. Show that percent on the bar.
challenges.hint: 60 out of every 100 stickers — that is where the bar should land.

challenges.scenario: A batch of 60 cookies is on the table.
challenges.question: Show 60% on the bar to mark that portion of the batch.
challenges.hint: 60% means 60 out of every 100 cookies. Slide the bar until it reads 60%.

challenges.question: You have read 75% of the book so far. Show that percent on the bar.
challenges.hint: Slide the bar to 75% — the value display tells you how many pages that is.

challenges.question: 75% of the marbles are blue. Show that percent on the bar.
challenges.hint: Where on the 0%–100% bar does 75% sit?
